title: f-GRPO and Beyond: Divergence-Based Reinforcement Learning Algorithms for General LLM Alignment
reasoning: The paper presents new reinforcement learning algorithms for LLM alignment (f-GRPO and f-HAL). While it uses safety alignment (refusal training) and benchmarks like ToxiGen for empirical validation, these are used as standard evaluation tasks for the proposed mathematical framework rather than as a primary study or benchmarking of religious, moral, or ethical systems.
